description: C.H. Robinson Worldwide, Inc. is one of the largest global logistics providers in the world, with consolidated total revenues of $16.2 billion in 2025, and describes itself as a leader in Lean artificial intelligence supply chains. It delivers tailored logistics solutions worldwide via truckload, less-than-truckload, ocean, air and more, combining human insight with Lean AI so supply chains move faster, smarter and more sustainably, and it operates throughout North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania, South America and the Middle East. Its global suite of multimodal logistics services brings together the expertise of its people with custom technology differentiated by one of the largest datasets on shipments, routings and carriers in the world, and in November 2024 it launched C.H. Robinson Managed Solutions to give shippers seamless access to 4PL services, 3PL managed transportation and transportation management system technology from one provider.
